intelligence.enrichment: Microorganisms such as fungi and bacteria grow on dead matter and act on waste in nature. Dead plants, dead trees, and other dead matter provide material on which decomposer microorganisms grow. The learner correctly applies this rule: Microorganisms such as fungi and bacteria grow on dead matter and act on waste in nature. Dead matter disappears on its own, and mushrooms are just umbrella-like growths on dead trees.
